categories.main_business_segments: Jiangyin Haida Rubber and Plastic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: rubber and plastic products, and aluminum products. The rubber and plastic segment focuses on sealing and vibration damping components for high-end equipment, serving industries such as rail transit, automotive, construction, and shipping. The aluminum segment, mainly through its subsidiary Konor Precision, specializes in high-precision automotive sunroof guide rails and other industrial aluminum extrusion products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary rubber modification technologies and multi-field integration strategies to develop sealing and vibration damping products. It employs advanced extrusion and injection molding techniques for rubber and plastic parts, and for aluminum products, it utilizes core technologies such as molten aluminum purification, liquid nitrogen cooling during extrusion, precise hardness control, mold development, and rapid profile inspection. The company also emphasizes automation and intelligent manufacturing systems like PLM, SRM, and MES to enhance production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major players in rail transit (e.g., high-speed trains, subways), automotive manufacturers (including OEMs and sunroof system suppliers like Webasto, Inalfa, Aisin), construction companies for building seals and isolation products, and shipping companies for container sealing components. The company also serves emerging markets in new energy sectors such as photovoltaic and hydrogen storage. Its products are widely used in China and have recognition in North America and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Jiangyin, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded overseas with a factory in Romania and sales in North America and Europe. The export business accounts for about 8% of total revenue, with the majority of sales domestic. The company also has subsidiaries and investments in cities like Ningbo, Chongqing, and overseas in Singapore and Romania.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangyin Haida operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying customized rubber, plastic, and aluminum components to OEMs and system integrators. It procures raw materials such as rubber and aluminum ingots from upstream suppliers and delivers finished components directly to end customers or assembly partners downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in rubber modification, sealing, and vibration damping, with a strong emphasis on green, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly materials. It actively collaborates with universities and research institutes to develop new materials and products, including self-adhesive sealing strips for rail tunnels, automotive vibration damping gears, and lightweight aluminum extrusion profiles. The company is also investing in new energy sectors, such as photovoltaic component materials and hydrogen storage, aiming to capture growth opportunities from China's carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized rubber, plastic, and aluminum products based on customer orders. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with sales contracts specifying technical specifications, quantities, prices, and delivery terms. It also earns government subsidies related to R&D and environmental initiatives, but the main income source remains product sales to industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangyin Haida is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the rubber sealing and vibration damping industry, recognized as one of the top 10 rubber product companies in China. Its aluminum extrusion subsidiary is among the largest specialized suppliers of automotive sunroof guide rails in China, serving premium automotive brands. The company competes by leveraging proprietary technologies, product quality, and comprehensive customer service, aiming to replace imports and expand market share in high-end segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.31 billion, a 20.88% increase over the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 161.7 million, up 19.53%. Total assets reached RMB 3.85 billion, growing 7.11% year-over-year. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by expanding sales in automotive, rail transit, and shipping sectors, alongside increased R&D investment of over RMB 128 million (3.87% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological leadership in rubber compound formulation and multi-field integration to deliver durable, environmentally friendly, and high-performance sealing and vibration damping solutions. Its products are tailored to meet stringent requirements in extreme environments, offering features like flame retardancy, energy saving, and real-time monitoring. The aluminum extrusion business differentiates through precision manufacturing, lightweight design, and customized profiles that meet the demands of premium automotive customers, supported by recognized industry awards and certifications.
